name: Memory Meadow
source:
[i]There is a planet somewhere in the universe. This is where their story began.[/i]

The story is about a robot who suddenly opened her eyes at a trash dump and her story of living alone for a long time.

[From [url=https://pesky-panthera.itch.io/memory-meadow]itch.io[/url]]
